purpose: Rolling planner authority for Simple Weapon semantic tags. Claude implements exact planner rulings; later rounds append additional Simple Weapon identities.

vocabularyPolicy.rule: A weapon finalTags entry may use only a tag that is already used by at least one certified feat or certified talent semantic assignment.
vocabularyPolicy.ontologyGapPolicy: If an important recommendation concept cannot be expressed faithfully with the 183 used feat/talent tags, record it in ontologyGapCandidates instead of inventing or borrowing a runtime-only tag.

structuredMechanicsMayRemainUntagged: Accurate/Inaccurate qualities when no approved semantic equivalent exists

source.book: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Riot-control grenade that can hold targets in place for up to 3 rounds until they win the opposed grapple check.

rationale.ranged: The weapon resolves its use with the attacker's ranged attack roll.
rationale.control: Its defining effect denies movement rather than dealing normal damage.
rationale.battlefield_control: The adhesive affects every target in the blast radius and can hold multiple creatures in place.
rationale.grapple: Targets explicitly make grapple checks to resist or escape the adhesive.
rationale.restrain: A failed check leaves the target unable to move for the effect's duration.
rationale.opposed_check: The target's grapple check is explicitly opposed by the attacker's ranged attack roll.

adjudicationNotes: Do not add grenade, thrown, area_damage, or other weapon-runtime-only tags; they are outside the certified feat/talent-used vocabulary.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Simple chopping weapon with both a normal melee profile and an explicit thrown attack profile.

rationale.melee: The axe has a canonical melee attack profile.
rationale.offense_melee: Its normal use deals melee weapon damage.
rationale.ranged: The axe has an explicit thrown ranged attack profile.
rationale.offense_ranged: Its thrown profile deals weapon damage at range.

adjudicationNotes: No thrown tag is permitted because thrown is not in the certified feat/talent-used vocabulary.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Rifle-mounted melee blade that preserves melee threat and attacks of opportunity even after firing the rifle; detached it functions as a knife.

rationale.melee: Mounted on a rifle, the bayonet explicitly turns the rifle into a melee weapon; detached, it is treated as a knife.
rationale.offense_melee: Its canonical attack use deals melee weapon damage.
rationale.attack_of_opportunity: The text explicitly states that a mounted bayonet can make attacks of opportunity and preserves threatened squares after a ranged attack.

adjudicationNotes: Do not add rifle: rifle is not in the certified feat/talent-used vocabulary, and the bayonet remains a Simple Weapon identity.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Ranged bow whose wielder adds Strength modifier to damage.

rationale.ranged: The bow is a ranged weapon.
rationale.offense_ranged: Its normal function is a damaging ranged attack.
rationale.damage_bonus: The wielder's Strength modifier explicitly applies to bow damage.

adjudicationNotes: Arrow capacity and free-action reload remain structured weapon mechanics rather than semantic tags.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Basic bludgeoning melee weapon with no additional special weapon rule.

rationale.melee: The club/baton is used as a melee weapon.
rationale.offense_melee: Its canonical function is to deal melee weapon damage.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Worn gloves add +1 damage to successful unarmed attacks and cannot be disarmed or dropped.

rationale.melee: Combat gloves operate through unarmed melee attacks.
rationale.offense_melee: They directly improve melee attack damage.
rationale.unarmed: Their bonus applies specifically to successful unarmed attacks.
rationale.damage_bonus: They add +1 damage to a successful unarmed attack.

adjudicationNotes: The cannot-be-disarmed/dropped rule stays in structured canonical mechanics; no existing feat/talent tag needs to duplicate it.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Contact-detonated ranged explosive delivering an immediate high-damage 8d6 attack across its burst area.

rationale.ranged: The grenade is resolved as a ranged attack.
rationale.offense_ranged: Its primary role is delivering direct damage at range.
rationale.burst_damage: Its defining combat role is a single high-impact 8d6 damage event, matching the existing feat/talent meaning of burst damage as concentrated spike damage.

adjudicationNotes: Do not add area_damage, grenade, explosives, or thrown because those tags are not used by certified feats/talents.
Area geometry remains structured canonical mechanics and does not need a semantic tag duplicate.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Compact melee contact weapon with a stun setting and +5 equipment bonus to Stealth checks made to conceal it.

rationale.melee: The weapon's contact strike is a melee attack.
rationale.stun: It has an explicit stun setting with its own stun damage.
rationale.nonlethal: The stun mode provides a nonlethal attack role.
rationale.concealment: The weapon explicitly improves attempts to conceal the weapon itself.
rationale.stealth: It grants a +5 equipment bonus to Stealth checks made to conceal it.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Single-bolt ranged crossbow that requires a move action to reload.

rationale.ranged: The crossbow is a ranged weapon.
rationale.offense_ranged: Its primary function is a damaging ranged attack.
rationale.move_action: Reloading the crossbow explicitly requires a move action.
rationale.action_economy: Its reload procedure directly consumes combat action economy.

adjudicationNotes: The Inaccurate quality remains structured canonical mechanics; do not invent an accuracy/inaccurate semantic tag.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Self-recocking ranged crossbow with a 10-quarrel magazine that is replaced as a move action.

rationale.ranged: The repeating crossbow is a ranged weapon.
rationale.offense_ranged: Its primary function is a damaging ranged attack.
rationale.move_action: Replacing its 10-quarrel magazine explicitly requires a move action.
rationale.action_economy: Magazine replacement directly consumes combat action economy.

adjudicationNotes: Magazine size and ammunition structure remain canonical mechanics rather than semantic tags.

source.book: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Damaging ranged grenade whose Fortitude rider reduces a target's speed to 2 squares until the end of its next turn.

rationale.ranged: The grenade resolves as a ranged attack.
rationale.offense_ranged: It deals direct damage at range.
rationale.control: Beating Fortitude imposes a temporary speed restriction on the target.
rationale.battlefield_control: The speed reduction constrains enemy movement and tactical options.
rationale.movement: The published rider directly changes the target's movement speed.

adjudicationNotes: Do not add grenade, thrown, area_damage, or cold; they are not part of the certified feat/talent-used tag vocabulary.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Short-range dart launcher that can deliver poison on damage or fire surveillance taggers.

rationale.ranged: The darter launches darts as ranged attacks.
rationale.offense_ranged: Its dart attack can deal damage and deliver payload effects at range.
rationale.poison: A poison-carrying dart explicitly delivers its toxin when the attack deals damage.
rationale.recon: The weapon explicitly supports surveillance taggers, giving it a reconnaissance use beyond direct damage.
rationale.tracking: Surveillance taggers are explicitly supported payloads for following or monitoring a tagged target.

adjudicationNotes: The source-unresolved dart/ammo capacity remains unresolved and must not be inferred from production.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Concealed code-cylinder dagger; +5 to Stealth checks to hide it and unusually difficult to detect by touch.

rationale.melee: The datadagger has a canonical melee attack profile.
rationale.offense_melee: Its weapon profile deals melee piercing damage.
rationale.concealment: Its defining special mechanic makes the weapon unusually easy to conceal and harder to detect by touch.
rationale.stealth: It grants a +5 equipment bonus to Stealth checks made to conceal the datadagger.

source.book: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Large archaic simple sword with no additional special rule.

rationale.melee: The dire sword is a melee weapon.
rationale.offense_melee: Its canonical function is dealing melee weapon damage.

source.book: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Simple double sword; both ends can attack as part of the full-round double-weapon attack procedure.

rationale.melee: Both attack profiles are melee attacks.
rationale.offense_melee: Both ends deal melee weapon damage.
rationale.double_weapon: The weapon explicitly has two usable weapon ends and is governed by double-weapon rules.
rationale.full_attack: Attacking with both ends uses the full-round double-weapon attack procedure.

adjudicationNotes: Do not add dual_wield solely because the item is double-ended; the existing ontology distinguishes double_weapon from dual_wield.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Ranged ion burst that can heavily condition and disable droids, vehicles, electronics, and cybernetically enhanced targets.

rationale.ranged: The EMP grenade resolves as a ranged attack.
rationale.offense_ranged: It deals ion damage through a ranged attack.
rationale.control: Qualifying electronic/cybernetic targets can be moved five steps down the condition track and disabled.
rationale.battlefield_control: The effect applies across a burst and can disable multiple qualifying targets in an area.
rationale.droid: Droids are explicitly among the primary targets that suffer the full ion/disable effect.
rationale.vehicle: Vehicles are explicitly among the primary targets that suffer the full ion/disable effect.
rationale.tech: The weapon is specifically effective against electronic devices and cybernetic technology.

adjudicationNotes: No condition_track tag is allowed because that runtime tag has not been used by certified feats/talents; control expresses the effect without creating weapon-only vocabulary.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Gungan ranged projectile whose range mode changes by delivery device; cesta delivery explicitly makes it Accurate.

rationale.ranged: Every certified delivery method uses the energy ball as a ranged projectile.
rationale.offense_ranged: Its canonical role is dealing ranged weapon damage.
rationale.precision: When hurled by a cesta it explicitly gains the Accurate quality; certified feat/talent use of precision includes direct attack-accuracy improvements.

adjudicationNotes: Do not add accuracy or thrown; neither is in the certified feat/talent-used vocabulary.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Multipurpose field tool usable as an improvised melee weapon at only -2 rather than the normal -5 penalty.

rationale.melee: Its certified weapon profile is melee.
rationale.offense_melee: When used as a weapon it deals melee damage.
rationale.improvised_weapon: Its defining combat rule explicitly replaces the normal improvised-weapon attack penalty.
rationale.equipment: It is fundamentally a multipurpose field tool that can also be used as a weapon.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Powered melee cutting blade that ignores the damage reduction of unattended objects.

rationale.melee: The fire blade has a canonical melee attack profile.
rationale.offense_melee: Its primary combat function is dealing melee weapon damage.

ontologyGapCandidates.mechanic: Ignores the damage reduction of unattended objects.
ontologyGapCandidates.reason: No tag already used by certified feats/talents cleanly represents offensive DR penetration against objects. damage_reduction means mitigating incoming damage and must not be repurposed.

adjudicationNotes: Do not use damage_reduction for DR penetration.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Tusken double melee weapon with distinct cutting and bludgeoning ends; both ends can attack in a full-round action.

rationale.melee: Both certified attack profiles are melee attacks.
rationale.offense_melee: Both ends deal melee weapon damage.
rationale.double_weapon: The Gaderffii explicitly functions as a double weapon with two distinct ends.
rationale.full_attack: Using both ends is resolved through its full-round double-weapon attack procedure.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Ranged gas blast using native stun damage, condition-track penalties, and temporary concealment.

rationale.ranged: The gas grenade resolves as a ranged attack.
rationale.offense_ranged: It delivers an offensive stun-damage effect at range.
rationale.stun: Its certified damage mode is native stun damage.
rationale.nonlethal: The stun-damage mode provides a nonlethal combat role.
rationale.control: A successful effect moves targets down the condition track.
rationale.battlefield_control: The gas blast affects an area and can hinder multiple targets simultaneously.
rationale.concealment: The gas cloud explicitly provides temporary concealment.

adjudicationNotes: Do not add condition_track or grenade; neither is in the certified feat/talent-used vocabulary.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Ranged contact-detonated burst weapon dealing 4d6 damage across its affected area.

rationale.ranged: The frag grenade resolves as a ranged attack.
rationale.offense_ranged: Its primary role is direct ranged damage.
rationale.burst_damage: It delivers a concentrated single-use spike of damage across its burst, consistent with the existing feat/talent burst-damage concept.

adjudicationNotes: Area geometry is preserved in canonical mechanics rather than represented by a new weapon-only tag.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Ranged ion burst especially effective against droids, vehicles, electronics, and cybernetic targets.

rationale.ranged: The ion grenade resolves as a ranged attack.
rationale.offense_ranged: It deals ion damage through a ranged attack.
rationale.control: Ion damage is mechanically intended to impair qualifying technological targets rather than merely reduce hit points.
rationale.droid: Droids are a primary target class for ion effects.
rationale.vehicle: Vehicles are a primary target class for ion effects.
rationale.tech: The ion effect directly targets electronic and cybernetic technology.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Ranged burst weapon that deals immediate damage and additionally exposes targets to Moderate radiation for damage and Treat Injury purposes.

rationale.ranged: The radiation grenade resolves as a ranged attack.
rationale.offense_ranged: It deals direct damage through a ranged attack.
rationale.sustained_damage: The attack also exposes targets to Moderate radiation, extending harmful consequences beyond the immediate hit.
rationale.treat_injury: The published mechanic explicitly states that the radiation exposure applies for Treat Injury purposes.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Ranged smoke weapon that fills a 2-square burst with concealment and a smoke hazard for 10 rounds.

rationale.ranged: The smoke grenade is delivered through a ranged attack.
rationale.control: Its primary function is to alter visibility and movement-space conditions rather than deal damage.
rationale.battlefield_control: It creates a persistent 2-square smoke zone that changes tactical use of the affected area for 10 rounds.
rationale.concealment: The published effect explicitly provides concealment.

adjudicationNotes: Do not add stealth merely because concealment may enable stealth; the weapon itself does not modify Stealth checks.
Do not add grenade, thrown, or area_damage; those are outside the certified feat/talent-used vocabulary.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Ranged 2-square burst dealing native stun damage with condition-track effects; droids, vehicles, and objects are immune.

rationale.ranged: The stun grenade resolves as a ranged attack.
rationale.offense_ranged: It directly delivers damaging stun effects at range.
rationale.stun: Its certified damage mode is native stun damage.
rationale.nonlethal: The weapon's defining damage mode is the system's nonlethal stun mechanic.
rationale.control: Stun damage can move affected targets down the condition track.
rationale.battlefield_control: The burst can impose stun/control effects on multiple targets in an area.

adjudicationNotes: Do not add droid or vehicle: those targets are immune rather than favored or supported targets.
Do not add condition_track because that tag is not used by certified feats/talents.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Silent simple melee blade with certified thrown capability.

rationale.melee: The knife's primary certified profile is melee.
rationale.offense_melee: It deals melee slashing or piercing damage.
rationale.ranged: The frozen canonical authority marks the knife as throwable, giving it a ranged attack use.
rationale.offense_ranged: When thrown, the knife deals weapon damage at range.

adjudicationNotes: Do not add stealth solely from the descriptive statement that a knife is silent; no Stealth modifier or stealth-resolution rule is granted.
Do not add thrown because that tag is outside the certified feat/talent-used vocabulary.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Basic metal bludgeoning melee weapon.

rationale.melee: The mace has a canonical melee attack profile.
rationale.offense_melee: Its canonical function is dealing melee weapon damage.

source.book: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Ceremonial Mythosaur-bone melee axe; Mandalore the Ultimate's special powered version is a named-character variant, not the generic identity.

rationale.melee: The generic Mythosaur axe has a canonical melee attack profile.
rationale.offense_melee: Its generic weapon function is dealing melee slashing damage.

adjudicationNotes: Do not tag the generic identity from Mandalore the Ultimate's named special double-damage powered variant.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Ranged grab/grapple weapon; targets can escape with Acrobatics or Strength, and the wielder can use Pin or Trip.

rationale.ranged: The net initiates grab or grapple attempts at range.
rationale.control: Its purpose is to hinder and contain a target rather than deal normal weapon damage.
rationale.battlefield_control: A successful net use restricts enemy freedom of movement and action at range.
rationale.grab: The text explicitly allows a ranged grab.
rationale.grapple: The text explicitly allows a ranged grapple.
rationale.restrain: The net can hold a target and explicitly supports Pin.
rationale.acrobatics: An affected target can explicitly escape with a DC 15 Acrobatics check.

ontologyGapCandidates.mechanic: The wielder may explicitly use the Trip feat with a net.
ontologyGapCandidates.reason: No tag already used by certified feats/talents represents Trip as a distinct weapon synergy. General control tags do not encode the specific feat interaction.

adjudicationNotes: Do not invent a trip tag in the weapon authority.
Crush and Throw are explicitly disallowed and therefore must not contribute semantic tags.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Simple double melee weapon; both ends can be used in a full-round double-weapon attack.

rationale.melee: Both ends of the quarterstaff are melee attack profiles.
rationale.offense_melee: Both ends deal melee weapon damage.
rationale.double_weapon: The rules explicitly identify the quarterstaff as a double weapon.
rationale.full_attack: Using both ends requires the published full-round attack procedure.

adjudicationNotes: Do not add dual_wield merely because both ends can be attacked with; double_weapon is the precise existing semantic tag.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Ranged 3-square flash burst that deals no damage but gives all other targets total concealment from each affected creature until the next turn.

rationale.ranged: The flash canister is delivered as a ranged attack.
rationale.control: Its effect denies affected creatures normal visual targeting rather than dealing damage.
rationale.battlefield_control: The burst can simultaneously disrupt multiple creatures' ability to see and engage other targets.
rationale.concealment: The published mechanic explicitly grants total concealment against each affected creature.

adjudicationNotes: No separate blindness/vision-denial tag is needed here because the published mechanic is explicitly expressed through total concealment.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Accurate Yuuzhan Vong biotech ranged weapon using simple-weapon ranges despite being thrown by hand.

rationale.ranged: The razor bug has a canonical ranged attack profile.
rationale.offense_ranged: Its primary role is dealing ranged slashing damage.
rationale.precision: The weapon is explicitly Accurate and takes no short-range attack penalty; certified feat/talent use of precision covers direct attack-accuracy improvements.
rationale.biotech: The frozen canonical authority identifies the razor bug as a Yuuzhan Vong bio-weapon.

adjudicationNotes: Do not add accuracy or thrown because those tags are outside the certified feat/talent-used vocabulary.

source.book: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Programmable ranged explosive deployed for remote detonation with a dedicated transmitter and a 100-meter safety interlock.

rationale.ranged: The remote grenade has a canonical ranged attack profile.
rationale.offense_ranged: It delivers direct damage at range.
rationale.burst_damage: Its 4d6 detonation is a concentrated single-event damage effect, consistent with the established burst_damage semantic.
rationale.setup: Its defining mechanic requires deployment and remote detonation rather than only immediate attack use.
rationale.trap: Remote placement and later detonation directly support prepared trap-style use.

adjudicationNotes: Do not add ambush solely because a remotely detonated explosive could be used during an ambush; the published rule directly supports setup/trap behavior, not a specific ambush mechanic.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Powered gloves add +1 unarmed damage and can switch the wearer's unarmed attacks to stun damage as a swift action.

rationale.melee: Shockboxing gloves operate through unarmed melee attacks.
rationale.offense_melee: They directly improve melee attack damage.
rationale.unarmed: Both lethal and stun profiles apply specifically to the wearer's unarmed attacks.
rationale.damage_bonus: They add +1 damage to successful unarmed attacks.
rationale.stun: They can convert the wearer's unarmed damage to stun damage.
rationale.nonlethal: The stun setting provides a nonlethal combat mode.
rationale.swift_action: Switching the gloves to stun is explicitly a swift action.
rationale.action_economy: The stun-mode switch directly consumes a defined combat action.

adjudicationNotes: The cannot-be-disarmed/dropped rule remains structured canonical mechanics.

source.book: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Compact simple melee sword commonly used in two-weapon fighting, but with no standalone mechanical two-weapon or defensive bonus.

rationale.melee: The short sword has a canonical melee attack profile.
rationale.offense_melee: Its canonical function is dealing melee weapon damage.

adjudicationNotes: Do not add dual_wield from descriptive usage alone.
Do not add defense or deflect from flavor text; the published entry grants no standalone numerical or rules benefit for deflecting melee attacks.
